title: Stacks
subtitle: Keep only unfinished work: LIFO order exposes the most recent unresolved context or nearest useful candidate.
variables: n = input elements/tokens, h = stack height, d = nesting depth, V/E = reachable graph vertices/edges, R = expanded output length. Costs assume constant-time primitive comparison/arithmetic on bounded-size values; Python big-integer operations add bit costs. list append is amortized O(1); a resize can be O(h). List end pop is amortized O(1), including occasional shrinking. Auxiliary space excludes returned output unless specified; iterative stacks count as auxiliary just as recursion frames do. Hash-set graph bounds are expected. All templates are Python 3.10+ standard library and avoid recursion-depth dependence.
